ownerAssistant.introTitle: What do you want to check on the site?
ownerAssistant.intro: I look up users, credits, payments, subscriptions, searches, feedback, blog, audit log, Leadtita conversations, analytics and AI cost. I propose changes and you confirm them.
ownerAssistant.example1: Summarize revenue and AI cost for the last 30 days
ownerAssistant.example2: Which users signed up this week and how many credits do they have?
ownerAssistant.example3: Show me the most recent open feedback
ownerAssistant.placeholder: Ask about metrics, users or request a change…
ownerAssistant.hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.
ownerAssistant.statusStale: Already applied, or the data changed since I proposed it. Ask me again.
ownerAssistant.statusExpired: This card expired. Ask me again.

permissions.title: How much can it do on its own?
permissions.help: Choose which changes Leadtita Staff applies without asking you.

hints.skip: Asks before deleting, touching credits, subscriptions or publishing.

danger.title: Turn on Danger mode
danger.intro: Leadtita Staff will apply every change without asking you.
danger.risk1: It can delete accounts, searches and posts instantly.
danger.risk2: It can change credits and subscription statuses without your review.
danger.risk3: Deleted data can't be restored. It turns off when the page reloads.
